Benzphetamine is indicated for the management of exogenous obesity as a short-term adjunct (a few weeks) in a weight reduction regimen based on caloric restriction for patients with an initial body mass index (BMI) of ≥30 kg/m² who have not responded to appropriate weight-reducing regimens (diet and/or exercise) alone. The initial dose is 25-50 mg orally once daily, which may be increased in dose or frequency based on response, up to three times daily. 2. The safety and efficacy of benzphetamine in patients under 12 years of age have not been established. For patients aged 12 years and older, the initial dose is 25-50 mg orally once daily, with the possibility of increasing the dose or frequency based on response, up to three times daily. 3.
